Personnel and material flow into and out of the ISO 7 and ISO 8 classified areas occurs through a single shared pathway that passes directly through the visual inspection and labeling room. Gowning, degowning, and material transfer -including finished product exiting the cleanroom and incoming components entering -all traverse the same corridor used for labeling and visual inspection of previously released product, creating a convergence of traffic that is inconsistent with unidirectional flow principles.
